D1.text: The data owner determined a Raspberry Pi could host a KwaaiNet node. The node utilized keys, an embedding model, a mapping table, and a plaintext store. Inference was deemed unsuitable due to bandwidth limitations. A gnu build was compiled, emitting ARMv8.2 instructions. The musl build was selected to avoid these instructions. Installation was performed manually to ensure compatibility with glibc version 2.34.

D2.text: Data integrity requires a dedicated, always-on system for input/output operations, unsuitable for computationally intensive tasks like inference. The system’s architecture must align with its core components, avoiding incompatible instruction sets.
